title: SyncSetting
description: Describes how often, and how much history, should be fetched for the given data type when a pull operation is queued.

fetchOnFirstLink.description: Whether this data type should be queued after a company has authorized a connection.

syncSchedule.description: Number of hours after which this data type should be refreshed.

syncOrder.description: The sync in which data types are queued for a sync.

syncFromUtc.description: Date from which data should be fetched. Set this *or* `syncFromWindow`.

syncFromWindow.description: Number of months of data to be fetched. Set this *or* `syncFromUTC`.

monthsToSync.description: Months of data to fetch, for report data types (`balanceSheet` & `profitAndLoss`) only.
